name: Park loop

gates.name: Under the bar of the post gate
Up between the power line's wires
Past the fountain, inside its rim

notes: Park: an easy, open course. The post gate (posts at x 30-31 and 40-41, z 10-11, bar from 6 to 7 m); the power line's wires at mid-span between the poles at x -25 and 25 (links.ts: pins 11.61 m up, 0.6 m sag, wires at z -41.1, -40.4 and -38.9, so 1.5 m between the last two; 1 m east of mid-span, where the wire is 11.016 m up, not on a joint of its pieces); the fountain (column 0.8 m round, basin 7 m to its corners, water at 0.62 m); the gazebo (posts at x -70 and -62, z 110 and 118, roof from 3 m; the gate between its west posts); the pond (x 50-95, z 100-140).
